description: A value of type `T` that will be available later. `await` and `.then` unwrap it to `T`.
Always returns a promise. Annotate the return type as `Promise<T>`.
Runs promises concurrently and resolves to a tuple of their values; rejects on the first failure.
Settles like the first promise that settles. The basis for timeouts.
A promise that is neither awaited nor handled. Its rejection goes unnoticed.
